scripts.preview:alias: printf %s "${WORKERS_CI_BRANCH:-$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr -cs 'a-z0-9' '-' | cut -c1-63 | sed 's/^-*//; s/-*$//'
scripts.preview:upload: pnpm run preview:build && pnpm --filter @sendtally/web exec wrangler versions upload --preview-alias "$(pnpm -s run preview:alias)"
scripts.staging:web: pnpm run preview:build && pnpm --filter @sendtally/web exec wrangler deploy
scripts.staging:api: pnpm --filter @sendtally/sync-service exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote && pnpm --filter @sendtally/sync-service exec wrangler deploy --env staging
